answer: opal-reverb: each attestation is countersigned by a seeded sample of the attester's own prior attesters, its public reverberation ring. A sybil farm's puppets only attest to each other, so their rings are built from the farm's own identities and the ring-overlap graph exposes the topology. To fake a ring the farm must run real agents that countersign its puppets, and those rings point back, forcing a live web across every puppet. One broken edge is a provable lie that burns the bond. A fable of faked rings costs a live web per puppet, and a farm's zenith of standing is capped by weakest ring.
